meta.title: Reviewing with an outside address bounces back the same way
gaps: Connect or verify the company's approval mailbox and two-step email approval workflow
Sign in to Asha's mailbox and open the Procol approval request
Click Review, enter the comment and outsider.qa@gmail.com as the recipient, and send without changing the subject
Wait for Procol to process the mailbox reply
Observe the bounce-back message stating that the outside address is not part of the organisation on Procol
Verify that no review is created as a result of the email
